seo.metaDescription: Specimen Bio runs biospecimen procurement end to end for sponsors and providers.

subheading: We are not a marketplace or a broker. We run procurement end to end with providers and match end users' needs to qualified providers globally.

paragraphs: Lots of sites list biospecimens. Few teams know the science, know the providers personally, and own the work through delivery.
We have spent decades on small specialist collections and large multi-site studies. We only recommend providers we have worked with. We stay on the project until your samples arrive and meet spec.

demandCard.heading: For biospecimen end users
demandCard.body: We work with pharma, biotech, in-vitro diagnostic, and device companies who have us source human biospecimens for their R&D needs which often include biomarker discovery, drug development & disease research, regulatory submissions, verification and validation.
features: Access to a global Provider Network

supplyCard.heading: For biospecimen providers
supplyCard.body: We work with clinics, hospitals, institutes, pathology and diagnostic labs, biobanks, and biorepositories, as well as CROs and others, connecting qualified Providers with End User needs.
features: Access to end users' biospecimen requests

subtext: Same seven steps on a single-site collection or a multi-site prospective collection program.

steps.title: Orientation
steps.description: We take time to understand your scientific needs, timeline, and constraints.

steps.title: Definition
steps.description: We develop and have you approve a detailed project spec, which drives the rest of the work.

steps.title: Feasibility
steps.description: We match your needs to suitable providers from our global network.

steps.title: Matching
steps.description: We propose selected Provider(s) to you, handle agreements, and all other logistics to start collection.

steps.title: Collection
steps.description: We coordinate and oversee the project from inception to collection, keeping you up-to-date of the progress.

steps.title: Logistics
steps.description: We arrange shipping with qualified couriers so samples arrive safely and on time.

steps.title: Acceptance
steps.description: You sign off when samples meet spec so we can close the project.

heading: Sourcing: What and Where
subtext: Any geography, any disease area, any sample type.

heading: 25+ years in the field
paragraphs: Peter M. Nowacki founded Specimen Bio after twenty-plus years in biospecimen leadership, including General Manager of the Biospecimen Procurement Business Unit at Azenta Life Sciences and COO at Trans-Hit Biomarkers.
Specimen Bio fills the gap he kept seeing: accountable ownership from first call to confirmed delivery.
